scripts.dev: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm --filter @realtime-events/server run dev
scripts.dev:playground: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm --filter @realtime-events/playground run dev
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && eslint . --max-warnings=0 && echo "\033[32m✓ Done\033[0m"
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && eslint . --fix && echo "\033[32m✓ Fixed\033[0m"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
